recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future corrections to detailed external genetics code-system registrations should be handled in HL7 Terminology/THO, not by reintroducing the old core FHIR table.
issue_request: FHIR-18790 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 vocabulary correction asking that broken links in the Code Systems page's "Code Systems for Genetics" table be fixed.
initial_application: The Jira comment names git commit 4907f9bcb0b710cb2837a93a20c4b23210a37249. Inspecting that commit shows source/terminologies-systems.html was changed so each Genetics row retained its anchor in the URI cell and used an href link in the description cell.
additional_context: The current build-scope terminology page is source/terminologies-systems.html, linked from source/terminology-module.html. It no longer contains the old Genetics subsection and instead tells readers to use HL7 Terminology for authoritative external code-system information. Later Published issue FHIR-37853 established THO as the source of truth for external code and identifier system information and removed old external rows that lacked FHIR usage guidance, including the Genetics table.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because there are no current core Genetics table links to fix, and restoring or editing that removed table would conflict with the later THO source-of-truth decision.
